programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his son, Logan visit the beautiful country of New Zealand. From visiting Vineyards and sampling wine, to helicopter hunts for Himalayan Tahr, this episode is everything that is a hunters dream. As well as harvesting the wild game New Zealand has to offer Andy also learns about the importance of the conservation efforts that hunting has in this country from locals in which he spends time with.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of Salmon fishing and hunting black tail deer. Whilst traversing steep mountains in the company of Kodiak brown bears and taking on cold Alaskan waters, Andy presents useful information for fellow outdoor enthusiasts all whilst building friendships with the great people of Kodiak Big Timber Lodge.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 1 of the British episodes, Andy starts his road trip around the United Kingdom in the Cotswolds where he sets out to hunt and taste the beautiful venison that Michelin star chef, Mark Robinson has to offer. He then proceeds to travel to the border of Scotland where he samples some of the finest and most historic bird shooting practices found throughout the British Isles.

programme.title: Local Lines
programme.desc: Orange Lake is a bass angler's paradise, known for its enormous trophy bass. On this episode of Local Lines TV, we dive into these rich waters to uncover the secrets of catching these giants. Get ready for thrilling action and expert tips from Brandon Branch and Trevor Fitzgerald.

programme.title: Local Lines

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Rush teams up with longtime friend and fellow angler Jesus Diaz for a well-earned "busman's holiday" in the beautiful waters of Key West. programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: In the heart of the Zambezi Delta, a team of conservationists have overseen one of the largest range expansions of African lions in modern times. From a reintroduction of 24 lions in 2018, today the population is more than a hundred.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: For many protected reserves across Africa, the elephant populations are expanding, and this comes with a critical problem: what happens to the elephants when an area reaches carrying capacity? Dan Cabela investigates the growing problem, visiting Zimbabwe, Namibia and Angola to explore the future of elephant conservation.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Melissa Bachman has made her name over the last two decades as one of the most dedicated hunters and producers in the outdoor industry. In this episode we’ll tag along with Melissa while she chases big game around the world with her Winchester in hand. First we’ll head to Colorado as Melissa spot and stalks giant mule deer, then we’ll head across the pond to New Zealand to chase mountain ibex and tar, then head back to the states for Montana whitetail at ground level.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Shotgun sports are experiencing unprecedented growth, with competitions across the country gaining popularity as enthusiasts vie to be the best shooters in the world. Every summer, the Amateur Trapshooting Association hosts The Grand American in Sparta, Illinois. This year marks the 125th Anniversary for the largest trap shooting competition in the world. We’ll talk with the people who make this tournament run behind the scenes and explore what makes this tournament such a special event. We’ll also look at the rich history of The Grand. On-site we’ll chat with the curator of the Trapshooting Hall of Fame and look at some of the incredible historical pieces on display in the museum. Additionally, we’ll learn about White Flyer and how the clay manufacturer has made important innovations for the shotgun sports.

programme.title: Angry Birds Toons
programme.desc: Check out Angry Birds Toons compilations! Each compilation has several episodes from your favorite shows including Angry Birds, Piggy Tales, and Stella!

programme.title: Ebb and Flo
programme.desc: The world of Ebb and Flo is seen through Ebb’s eyes and Ebb reveals all the emotions grown-ups try to hide. Flo doesn’t think of Ebb as a dog, and Ebb doesn’t think of Flo as a small human, they just are the best of friends. Until Bird arrives to lovingly disrupt Ebb’s world. Ebb and Flo’s home is an old boat moored by the beach. Things Couldn’t Be Better!

programme.title: Bino & Fino
programme.desc: Bino & Fino is about a brother and sister named Bino and Fino who live with their grandparents 'Mama' and 'Papa' in a modern day city in Africa. Bino and Fino have many adventures where, with the help of their friend Zeena the Magic Butterfly, they discover and learn things about the world.

programme.title: Princess Play Time
programme.desc: The proud Princess likes to do things her own way, but her antics are always joined by her restless brother, Prince, who tends to turn everything topsy-turvy. Any playtime in their room transforms into a fantastic journey through unusual worlds: the children arrange a picnic on the Moon, conduct a detective investigation in a toy city, or search for pirate treasures on islands! Although initially, the Princess and Prince seem to clash and compete, by the end, they always find joy in each other's company and that of their cherished dog, Bona.

programme.title: Chefclub Kids
programme.desc: With Chefclub Kids, the little ones get their hands dirty all while having fun in the kitchen. Whether they're learning to prepare dinner, bake goodies, or explore new flavors, Chefclub Kids is a way for children to gain confidence through cooking!

programme.title: Hogie the Globehopper
programme.desc: Hogie the Globehopper is a fun tv show that will inspire a curiosity and fascination about the world and its people. Hogie and his friends Lorna, Bernie and Floaty travel the world, making lots of friends along the way.

programme.title: Mya Go
programme.desc: Mya Go is a preschool animated show about a young girl whose enthusiasm infects everyone around her. Set in the bustling town of Everyday, Mya Go lives here with the Go family and lives nearby her closest friends.

programme.title: Bernard
programme.desc: Follow Bernard as he makes a mess of things!

programme.title: The Fixies
programme.desc: The Fixies follows the comical misadventures of Tom Thomas and his secret friendship with Simka and Nolik, the children of the Fixie family that lives in his apartment. There’s just no end to the troubles Tom Thomas and his Fixie friends get themselves into with all the gadgets and appliances around them!

programme.title: Domi Kids
programme.desc: Domi Kids is a brand-new 3D animated musical series created by Leqing Media. With lively and engaging music, multiple characters bring to life the warm and joyful daily adventures of Domi and his family of five. The show features diverse themes, captivating stories, and vibrant scenes. A professional music production team ensures high-quality melodies, arrangements, and vocals, creating a delightful audiovisual experience for children. With positive and entertaining content, the series helps young kids learn about the world at an age-appropriate pace while supporting parents in making parenting easier and more enjoyable.

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: Misha, the Purple Cat
programme.desc: Misha is a very lively, alert cat. She is very interested in investigating everything going on around her, which means she has some very entertaining adventures with her friends. Many things can happen in Misha’s world; especially exciting adventures, mysterious investigations, hilarious competitions... all with a feeling of close friendship.

programme.title: BarryTiger
programme.desc: BarryTiger is a 3D animated musical series designed by the BarryTiger brand for children aged 1-8. With delightful and engaging music, multiple characters bring to life the everyday adventures of BarryTiger and his friends. The show features a wide range of themes, diverse scenes, and captivating content. A professional music production team ensures high-quality melodies, arrangements, and vocals, creating a true audiovisual feast for children.

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends Minis
programme.desc: Get ready to watch Talking Tom and Friends at their cutest! Mini in size, but massive in fun, the Minis check out the day-to-day world of the friends we all know and love where they do the most ordinary things in the most extraordinary ways.

programme.title: Leo the Wildlife Ranger
programme.desc: Leo the Wildlife Ranger introduces the secrets and wonders of nature and wildlife around us and kickstarts a curiosity and passion for nature in kids. With engaging missions and adventures, kids have fun while learning positive lessons!

programme.title: Counting With Paula
programme.desc: The show features Paula and her friends, Tim, Billy, Chalky, Calc, and the Numbers as they go on exciting adventures in colorful and exotic places. From the Amazon jungles to the deepest oceans, and to the hottest deserts, Paula and friends solve problems, have fun and make more friends along the way!

programme.title: MisterWives: The Don’t Look Down Tour: Live from The Wiltern
programme.desc: Indie-pop band MisterWives close out The Don’t Look Down Tour with an electrifying, sold-out performance at The Wiltern in Los Angeles. Fronted by Mandy Lee, the group performs a dynamic mix of hits and new songs from their album Nosebleeds, blending soaring vocals, raw emotion, and vibrant stage energy. The night captures the band’s message of resilience, growth, and celebration as they connect with fans in a transformative live experience.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Tim McIlrath of Rise Against to discuss the real-world impact of music, risks that comes with standing by your convictions on stage, the vulnerability of putting your flaws into every song, and what's coming next for the band, with two new songs on the way.

programme.title: Frank Turner & The Sleeping Souls: The First Four Albums (2012 Revisited) Live in Anaheim
programme.desc: Night 2 of Lost Evenings VI in Anaheim finds Frank Turner & The Sleeping Souls tearing through favorites and deep cuts from the first four albums—Sleep Is for the Week, Love Ire & Song, Poetry of the Deed, and England Keep My Bones. A charged, communal set featuring sing-alongs like “Try This at Home,” “Reasons Not to Be an Idiot,” “Nashville Tennessee,” “Peggy Sang the Blues,” “There Is No God,” and “If Ever I Stray/Keep Having Dreams,” captured live at House of Blues Anaheim.

programme.title: An Evening With Becky Lucas
programme.desc: Becky Lucas delivers a candid stand-up set with sharp, self-deprecating humor, sharing personal stories and punchlines from her early material with wit and honesty.

programme.title: Ice Nine Kills: I Heard They Kill Live 2
programme.desc: Watch I Heard They Kill Live 2, a live Ice Nine Kills concert film captured at Thanx-killing 2022 in Massachusetts.

programme.title: Lost Evenings VI: Night 4 – Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Frank Turner & The Sleeping Souls close out Lost Evenings VI in Anaheim with a sold-out, career-spanning set packed with fan favorites, sing-alongs and candid moments. Highlights include “1933,” “Recovery,” “The Next Storm,” “Miranda” and “Little Changes,” capping four nights of music and celebration.

programme.title: Kansas: Miracles out of Nowhere
programme.desc: A 2015 full-length documentary film tells the untold story of a successful American rock band. In-depth interviews with all 6 original members recount their rise.

programme.title: Foxing: Live at The Grandel
programme.desc: Foxing performs Draw Down The Moon in full, captured live at The Grandel in St. Louis for a concert film experience.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Dasha. Born in San Luis Obispo, California, Dasha started performing at ten and released her first song at thirteen. After years as an independent artist, her 2023 single "Austin (Boots Stop Workin')" went viral and landed her a deal with Warner Records. Since then, she's made her Grand Ole Opry debut, joined the Spotify Billions Club, and toured with Thomas Rhett and Luke Bryan.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Host Joel Madden talks with Jesse Leach, vocalist of Killswitch Engage, about the band’s legacy, mental health, and rediscovering balance after years on the road. Leach reflects on growing up in a religious home, finding community through punk and hardcore, and building a life grounded in creativity and purpose.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Country-rock singer-songwriter HARDY joins Joel Madden to talk about bridging the worlds of rock and country, evolving from songwriter to artist, and why connecting with fans matters most. They swap stories about small-town roots, creative identity, and finding value in authenticity over fame.

programme.title: Elevation Worship and Steven Furtick: Elevation Nights Live from Philadelphia
programme.desc: Elevation Worship and Steven Furtick perform the final stop of Elevation Nights 2024 in Philadelphia with a powerful live worship experience.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Magnolia Park frontman Joshua Roberts joins Joel Madden for a heartfelt conversation about anime, identity, and carving out space in rock music. Joshua reflects on navigating racism in the scene, channeling emotion into art, and leading Magnolia Park’s creative community with resilience and purpose. From social media strategy to self-belief, this episode dives deep into what it means to stay authentic while inspiring others to do the same.

programme.title: Carole King: Welcome to My Living Room
programme.desc: Carole King performs an intimate 2005 concert in Southern California, featuring 21 Top 40 hits from her legendary career.

programme.title: Judas Priest: Epitaph
programme.desc: Judas Priest performs a powerful final tour set at Hammersmith Apollo, featuring songs spanning their 40-year career.

programme.title: Improbably Poppy
programme.desc: In this surreal premiere, Poppy hits the streets of Monrovia offering eerie fortunes, interviews a survivor of the Dave Matthews Band bus disaster, and encounters Archduke Franz Ferdinand in a time-warping twist. Between absurd sketches and existential reflections, she performs a musical lesson on embracing chaos and taking risks. TV-14 (fictional violence, language).

programme.title: 10 Years of Noise and Confusion: Oasis Live at Barrowlands
programme.desc: Filmed live at Glasgow’s Barrowlands, Oasis performs Supersonic, Roll With It, and more in a “back to the roots” anniversary show capturing their raw live energy.

programme.title: Megadeth - Crush The World Tour Live from Buenos Aires – Night 1
programme.desc: Megadeth kicks off a two-night stand at Buenos Aires’ Movistar Arena on the Crush The World Tour. Filmed for Veeps, Night 1 delivers a blistering set of thrash classics and newer tracks, led by Dave Mustaine and fueled by the crowd’s relentless energy.

When a heist shuts down the megaplex, Jersey's most formidable mall cop will have to become a real cop to save the day.

But the van breaks down on the way, and they're forced to take jobs as dancing woodpeckers in a bank promotion. Their troubles are just beginning, as their feathered costumes are swiped by a pair of hoods who use them in a holdup, and Skip and Harry are soon carted off to prison. There they try to keep their sanity and their lives as they deal with a sadistic warden, a hulking mass-murderer and the inter-prison rodeo, which may provide them with the opportunity to walk away -- but at a considerable sacrifice.

Bernard is an elf who dreams of creating such inventions, but his job is to clean the reindeer stables! Yet when he creates an amazing Christmas memory machine, his luck might be changing. This year the real Santa Claus is coming to town.

When one of her clients falls ill, his son rushes home, who to Melody's surprise turns out to be none other than country music superstar, Johnny Colorado! As the unlikely pair grow closer, it looks like it could be the start of the perfect Christmas romance, until an old flame of Johnny's arrives at the family ranch....

programme.title: Christmas at the Ranch
programme.desc: When Haley Hollis returns to her family ranch, she wasn't banking on spending so much time with with ranch hand Kate - or falling for her.

programme.desc: A magical holiday adventure featuring original Christmas songs by Dolly Parton, and starring Golden Globe winner, Ed Asner (Elf, Up). The Whitehaven family embark on a whirlwind adventure to the North Pole when their beloved dog, Rusty, goes missing on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: The Claus Family
programme.desc: After discovering his grandfather is Santa Claus, Jules has to help him deliver his presents all around the world. But Jules' hatred for Christmas might make that more difficult than Santa thought.

programme.title: You Can't Fight Christmas
programme.desc: Interior decorator and Christmas fanatic, Leslie Major, has the yearly task of decorating the lobby of the famed Chesterton Hotel. But one fateful day whilst working on a ladder to reach the top of the tree, she falls into the arms of Edmund James, the grandson of the hotel's owner. However, Edmund is all business and plans to put an end to the annual tradition. Can Leslie work her magic and teach him to love Christmas?

programme.title: Elf Man
programme.desc: An Elf is left behind by Santa to help rescue the Harper family from a lousy Christmas. The Elf and the family get more than they bargained for, as the kids help the Elf discover his special powers and true identity as a budding superhero.

programme.title: Christmas Miracle (2014)
programme.desc: It's Christmas Eve in the sleepy town of Rockford when Sheriff Rick Langston (Dean Cain, Lois & Clarke: The New Adventures of Superman) arrests a mysterious man who resembles Santa Claus. However, when the townspeople's Christmas wishes all start to come true, the sheriff begins to wonder if this jolly old man just might be the real deal. It is when he is out of love and luck and at his most cynical that the sheriff meets Lucy (Christine Lakin, Valentine\s Day) and is shown the miracle of love and family. As Christmas Day fast approaches, new relationships are forged and existing ties are strengthened in this uplifting festival story for the whole family.

It will take a Christmas miracle of royal proportions for their hearts to meet as one.

programme.title: A Miracle on Christmas Lake
programme.desc: After the loss of his best friend on Christmas Eve, Bobby goes out onto the lake and makes a shocking discovery. When the land is bought, Bobby must rally the town to save it.

programme.title: A Christmas Kiss
programme.desc: A romantic drama in the backdrop of Christmas time in Wisconsin, revolving around two college sweethearts who rekindle their love during the holiday season

programme.title: The Magic Reindeer: The Flight Before Christmas
programme.desc: Niko the Reindeer enjoys his cool and carefree life in the Arctic, but that all changes when he is given his most surprising Christmas present ever - a little stepbrother named Jonni! Niko is unhappy about this new addition to the family, but when Jonni is kidnapped by eagles, Niko realises that it's down to him to fly off and rescue his brother!

programme.title: How to Ruin the Holidays
programme.desc: A festive family caper starring Amber Nash (Archer, Mr. Robot) as a struggling comedian who reluctantly returns home for Christmas. Upon her arrival, she must not only deal with her eccentric and wildly dysfunctional family, but ultimately has a life-changing decision to make about her father and special-needs brother.

programme.title: The Three Dogateers Save Christmas
programme.desc: When a couple of burglars make off with their family's presents and decorations, the Three Dogateers set off on a journey to sniff out the bad guys and save Christmas!

programme.title: The Nights Before Christmas
programme.desc: In this Christmas set horror, a pair of crazed killers have written a very special 'naughty' list of targets. You better watch out, as now they've checked it twice, all sorts of festive hell is about to break loose! When a series of murders in the run up to Christmas are found to be linked, FBI Special Agent Natalie Parker is tasked with tracking a pair of psychotic serial killers. But she soon discovers the couple are not only crazy, having met in and escaped from an asylum for the criminally insane, but have based their personas on Santa and Mrs Claus. As Christmas approaches, they slaughter their way through their special naughty list, playing a cat and mouse game with the FBI and leaving a trail of gruesome bloody bodies in their wake.

programme.title: Benji's Very Own Christmas Story
programme.desc: On a surprise visit to meet Kris Kringle, Benji and his friends are shocked to discover that he plans to take the night off on Christmas Eve!

programme.title: 12 Dogs of Christmas
programme.desc: A girl who uses dogs to teach people about the true meaning of Christmas during the Depression.

programme.title: Christmas Couple's Retreat
programme.desc: Three couples attend a retreat to strengthen their respective relationships under the guidance of a famed therapist. But as the holiday season unfolds, unexpected challenges arise when the therapist must confront some feelings of her own, and sparks fly when one couple's son unexpectedly falls for the charming retreat manager. Will this festive getaway reignite these couples' love, or will it lead them down an entirely new path?

programme.title: Christmas Ransom
programme.desc: In this festive comedy for the whole family, a pair of bumbling crooks break into a toy store on the verge of closing, and take the struggling owner hostage. Little do they know that two hideaway kids have also been locked in the store. With Christmas on the line, the kids team up with a heavily pregnant security officer in a series of hilarious and heartwarming escapades. Can they outwit the thieves and save both the store, and Christmas?

programme.title: On Angel Wings
programme.desc: One starry night, a shepherd boy is taken on a secret, magical night-flight to witness a Christmas miracle. Rachel is 8 and for the first time is allowed to join her brothers and sister to visit their grandfather, Amos, as he carries out his annual ritual of a night in the hills, where he worked as a young shepherd boy. Grandfather is delighted to see the children and a special bond is established between him and Rachel. He tells them how she reminds him of a magical night; he then proceeds to recount it. He explains how, ahead of the other shepherds protecting their flock with him, he is flown away by the Angel Gabriel, to be the first visitor to the newly born Christ child. This magical re-working of the nativity by the leading writer Michael Morpurgo (War Horse, Private Peaceful) is rich with human poignancy as we share this very special experience.

programme.title: 12 Days Of Giving
programme.desc: When Baxter Billings (David Blue - SGU Stargate Universe, Ugly Betty) wins a small fortune at his local shopping mall, he decides to become a Secret Santa to the people in his hometown. His anonymous philanthropy is contagious and soon enough the joy of giving at Christmas spreads across town. Along the way, Baxter forms a close friendship with Pamela (Ashley Jones - True Blood, The Bold and the Beautiful) and her young son Westin. He thinks he might be falling for Pamela... but there's one problem, he's already engaged! This Christmas, Baxter will have to choose between keeping promises or following his heart.

programme.title: Joseph and Mary
programme.desc: During a time of much civil unrest, a holy man, Rabbi Elijah, swears an oath to protect the two young sons of a persecuted man. But while Jesus survives King Herod's slaughter of the innocents, it tragically claims the lives of the boys Elijah swore to protect.Seeking to avenge their deaths, he begins his quest for retribution. But when he meets Joseph, Mary and their young son Jesus, the anger that fuels his revenge is questioned. Elijah is faced with a life-changing choice: should he kill, or should he choose forgiveness, and in doing so, contradict every scripture upheld by his forefathers? With a powerful performance from Kevin Sorbo (Hercules, God's Not Dead), Joseph and Mary, is a stirring story of inspiration and hope, and of mercy versus revenge, set in the years before Jesus became the man who ultimately changed the course of humanity forever.

programme.desc: What can a California girl do with a few dusty acres of land in rural Nebraska? So Kennedy Blaine wonders after she inherits a ranch in the small town of Valentine, Nebraska. As Kennedy makes arrangements to sell the property, she finds herself drawn to the ranch and to its attractive manager, Derek Sterling. She decides to spend the summer in her ancestral home and reconnect with family members. But soon Kennedy is subjected to harassment by someone who clearly wants her to leave Valentine. Depending on God’s protection and Derek’s assistance, she sets out to discover who is behind the offenses. But when her search reveals painful details about her family and raises questions about Derek’s own past, will Kennedy still want to know the truth?

programme.title: Pharaohs at War
programme.desc: The Hellenistic pharaohs have been fighting the Seleucid Empire. Until Pharaoh Ptolemy IV confronted Antiochos the Great at Raphia. We discover the naval and military strategy of the Ptolemies and the dramatic consequences of this war.

programme.title: Pharaohs at War
programme.desc: To regain the power and glory of the pharaohs Cleopatra defies Octavian in one of the greatest naval battles of Antiquity: the battle of Actium. Which leads to the downfall of Cleopatra and the Egyptian Empire, and the advent of Octavian as emperor.

programme.title: Bradley Walsh: Egypt's Cosmic Code
programme.desc: Bradley Walsh sets up his lifelong fascination with Ancient Egypt in this first episode. As an ex-Rolls Royce engineer, Bradley has many questions about Egypt's biggest icons – the Pyramids.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Captain Tony Nelson, an astronaut, is engaged to Melissa Stone, daughter of General Wingard Stone, his commanding officer. There he releases Jeannie, a beautiful blonde, who can perform magic with a blink of her eyes, from a bottle is which she has been imprisoned for ages. Jeannie tells Tony she is his slave forever. Except for water, they are to live off the land. Jeannie hides in Tony's canteen. Tony tries to make Jeannie understand that she is destroying the value of the mission, but she sticks with him. While Roger barely survives, Tony has every luxury, from food and a harem tent, to a final ride on a camel to finish the journey.Dr. Bellows is baffled to find that while Roger has lost twelve pounds, Tony has gained five. Tony tells Jeannie he is taking her with him, but imprisons her within her bottle, de-termined to go on the mission alone.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie is annoyed when Diane Rodney, a friend of Tony's, returns to town, determined to resume their old relationship. As a result, when Jeannie runs into Roger, while driving Tony's car, she accepts his invitation to dinner. Unaware that Jeannie is Roger's date, Tony instructs his friend in the fine art of courtship. Later, when Jeannie tells him she doesn't know her date's name, Tony begins to worry. When Diane arrives, Tony drags her all over town searching for Jeannie. The two couples finally meet at a nightclub. Alone with Jeannie, Tony demands she return home. Jeannie tells him she is going to listen to Roger's records.At Roger's apartment, Jeannie wards off all his attempts at romance. She leaves shortly before Tony pounds on the door looking for her. Tony points out to Roger all the mistakes he would be making if he married her. Convinced, Roger admits Tony has saved him from making a fool of himself. Jeannie is overjoyed by Tony's concern for her. Tony replies that, after all, he is only human.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie agrees not to date Roger if Tony doesn't go out with other girls. Then Tony and Roger are assigned to escort Russian cosmonauts Major Tiomkin and Major Posnovsky during a goodwill visit. Major Tiomkin proves to be a beautiful girl named Sonya, who immediately stakes a claim on Tony. Angered, Jeannie tells Tony she is going out with Roger. Tony imprisons Jeannie in her bottle. Jeannie maneuvers the bottle into the pocket of Roger's raincoat. Roger presents the bottle to Sonya. Tony gets involved in a fracas with General Barkley and Dr. Bellows in his unsuccessful try to get the bottle back. When Sonya opens the bottle, Jeannie appears. Pointing to Sonya as her new mistress, she tells the cosmonaut she can make her every wish come true.When the plane on which Sonya is scheduled to return leaves, Tony feels her country now has possession of a decisive secret weapon. Later, dripping furs and jewelry, Sonya comes to Tony's home. She tells him Jeannie has granted her fondest desire by turning her into a wealthy American. Sonya agrees to return the bottle if Tony marries her. Tony asks a last word with Jeannie. He tells Jeannie he can't marry Sonya. Jeannie solves the problem by creating a duplicate Tony for Sonya.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Unable to persuade Tony to marry her, Jeannie decides she needs a mother's counsel. She blinks her eyes and Mama appears. Mama assures Jeannie Tony will change his mind if he thinks Jeannie is going to marry Roger. Tony asks Roger if he has met Jeannie's parents. Then Dr. Bellows announces he has bought the lot across the street. Roger asks to meet Jeannie's parents. She produces a house on Dr. Bellows' lot. Tony sees Dr. Bellows and General Hadley approaching the lot. Responding to Tony's pleas, Jeannie makes the house vanish. General Hadley and Dr. Bellows see Tony sitting in the weeds sipping tea. Making the house reappear, Jeannie produces parents for Roger's visit.Tony comes to the house and forbids Jeannie to marry Roger. Then Dr. Bellows drives up. Seeing the house, he becomes distraught, and runs to Tony. As the house disappears again, they see Roger sitting in the weeds. The following day, Roger tells Tony he found himself wandering around a vacant lot. When he returned to apologize, Jeannie and the house were gone. Smiling at Jeannie, hiding in his desk drawer, Tony assures Roger he Will let him know if he ever meets Jeannie again.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Learning that Dr. Bellows has told General Peterson that Tony should marry for his emotional stability as an astronaut, Jeannie prepares for the wedding. She produces Phoney, a twin of Tony's, who starts romancing her as an example for Tony. Getting nowhere, Jeannie makes Phoney disappear. Later, Dr. Bellows sees a romantic interlude between Jeannie and Phoney and leaves Tony's house, certain a wedding has been set for the following Sunday afternoon. Although Tony tries to get out of his predicament, he realizes he is stuck when the General congratulates him on his coming wedding. Later, Tony tells Jeannie he is going through with the affair.Jeannie produces Phoney to show Tony how to act at the wedding. Phoney tries to get Jeannie to marry him before she makes him vanish. At the chapel, Jeannie runs away at the last moment. At home, Tony tries unsuccessfully to make Jeannie believe it was actually Phoney who appeared at the wedding. Sure it was Tony, Jeannie tells she ran away after deciding never to force herself on him. When Tony musingly asks what would happen had they gotten married, Jeannie insinuates he will never know.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie finds her strength and power to perform magic weakening. Tony makes her promise to rest during the day. At the base, Roger, pointing to an astrological chart in a magazine, tells Tony his horoscope shows a gorgeous brunette will enter Roger's life. Tony questions his belief in such nonsense. Later, Jeannie phones Tony and tells him she seems to be vanishing by degrees. Then she pops into his office. Reading Roger's magazine, she tells Tony it is the Day of the Ram, on which every Genie and her master must pilgrimage to Mecca, and standing in a precise spot, repeat the Sacred Words. Tony refuses to take her seriously, but begins to wonder when Roger introduces him to Diane, a beautiful brunette. Tony and Jeannie take off for Mecca.Since the city has changed, they run into difficulty locating the place where they must pronounce the Sacred Words. They find the place they are looking for is now a bank and break in. As they are about to be taken by the police, Jeannie begins to fade. Tony finds the correct spot and pronounces the incantation. Jeannie recovers and they leave for home. Thanking Tony for saving her life, Jeannie announces she is taking them to Paris for dinner. Deciding they have traveled enough for one day, Tony takes her to Cocoa Beach instead.

programme.title: Christmas At The Greenbrier
programme.desc: (2022) Festive rom com with Alicia Leigh Willis. Years after they last dated, widowed Abby and ex gridiron star Ben reunite at the Greenbrier. Will their romance kick off again this Christmas season?

programme.desc: (2019) Intriguing Christmas romance with Ashley Newbrough. A relationship advice columnist receives an unsigned love letter. But as she hunts for the mystery writer, can she also find true love?

programme.title: Annie Claus Is Coming To Town
programme.desc: Santa's daughter takes her first trip away from the North Pole during the Christmas season.

programme.title: A Christmas Break

programme.title: Christmas in Tahoe
programme.desc: (2021) Harmonious romcom with Laura Osnes, Kyle Selig and Pat Monahan. Claire needs a big act to save her festive show. But when her now-famous ex arrives in town, could love also be on the line-up?

programme.title: Christmas at Graceland
programme.desc: (2018) Festive rom-com with Kellie Pickler. During a buisness trip to Memphis, Laurel runs into old flame Clay, a local musician. This reignites her passion for music... and maybe something more.

programme.title: Once Upon a Christmas Miracle
programme.desc: (2018) Festive romance starring Aimee Teegarden. A life-saving transplant brings two strangers together - and as the holidays approach, a heartfelt connection turns into something more.

programme.title: Wedding Central
programme.desc: Mark Trombino and Carol Skladany, both of whom are described as “a little couple,” have faced unique challenges due to their height. Mark, who stands at 3 feet 3 inches tall, has adapted to the world around him by using extended pedals in his car, a booster seat, and seeking assistance at gas stations. Carol, at 3 feet 11 inches, had never had a serious boyfriend until age 41 and had given up on her lifelong dream of marriage and motherhood. Despite their individual struggles, they found love with each other, and their journey is documented in the context of preparing for their big day.

programme.title: Wedding Central
programme.desc: On an episode of “The Wedding Planners,” two different planners work with brides in different locations to plan their special weddings. Melissa Barrad in Southern California assists Rosie and Nandi in planning their wedding at a golf course overlooking the Pacific Ocean. They focus on details like choosing the best location for sunset photos and selecting floral arrangements. Tammy Cowart, on the opposite coast in Orlando, Florida, deals with Jill and Jack. She faces challenges such as hurricane force winds on the wedding day and a venue that requires significant improvements.

programme.title: Wedding Central
programme.desc: We are introduced to four planners from Austin, Texas, who collaborate to infuse their unique Texas style into every wedding they organize. Additionally, a planner from Southern California is passionate about creating dream weddings. Austin Planners:Kathie, Vivian, Jeff, and Kiley aim to transform a lakeside yacht club in Texas into a Moroccan beach resort for their couple, Lynsey and Seth. Since the bride and groom reside in Los Angeles, the planners must make decisions on color palettes, floral arrangements, and lounge furniture without direct input. Just hours before the wedding day, a hailstorm unexpectedly hits the lakeside location, adding to the challenges. Southern California Planner (Melissa Barrad): Melissa organizes an elegant wedding at a historical site in San Diego for her couple, Will and Kasey. Her primary concern is transitioning the formal ceremony setting into Kasey’s envisioned reception ballroom within a tight timeframe. Despite the unusually chilly California night, the guests patiently await the celebration.

programme.title: Wedding Central
programme.desc: Las Vegas, known for its neon-lit allure, attracts over 100,000 couples annually who choose to tie the knot in this vibrant city. Whether eloping or planning a destination wedding, Las Vegas offers a range of options. Couples can opt for simple chapel ceremonies starting at $40, or they can go all out with million-dollar weddings at high-end resorts. And for a truly iconic experience, they can even get married by the legendary Elvis Presley himself. From bustling marriage bureaus to gilded chapels, Las Vegas provides a unique and unforgettable wedding experience.

programme.title: My Fair Wedding With David Tutera
programme.desc: Wedding cake is important to every bride. But wedding planner David Tutera knows it has a deeper meaning to bride Kristina, who has struggled with an eating disorder. Kristina's fiancé wouldn't marry her until she was able to eat and enjoy the cake at their wedding. Now that Kristina is healthy, it's time to plan her April in Paris wedding. Trouble is, Kristina has everything from the Eiffel Tower to French poodles thrown into the mix! The bridesmaids chose their own dresses, and the reception venue is a hot tub resort an hour away. David creates a flower-filled fantasy of Parisian art and entertainment. Let them eat cake!

programme.title: My Fair Wedding With David Tutera
programme.desc: Bride Kristin went from a size 24 to a size 6 after having a stroke. Her fiancé stayed by her side through it all, and even lost 50 pounds himself! Now, Kristin wants her wedding to feel like she's at a Hawaiian luau. But her theme has become as tacky as a tiki torch. The flowers are fake, the bridesmaids are barefoot, and her backyard venue is hardly Hawaiian. Wedding planner David Tutera decides to show off his bride's new figure and her sweet nature, too. With fabulous fashion, flowers, and fire dancers David turns this bride's wedding into a real tropical dream.

programme.title: My Fair Wedding With David Tutera
programme.desc: Bride Candice Marie loves shabby chic. Her wedding theme has plenty of white, sparkle, and homey touches. Her thoughtful fiancé even made a shabby chic chandelier to hang over the sweetheart table. But most important of all to Candice Marie is the picture of her mother she wants to carry in her bridal bouquet. David Tutera discovers the shocking news that his bride's mom was murdered when Candice Marie was only four years old. This wedding is all about family and love. Candice Marie puts her trust in David, who gets busy transforming shabby chic into Candice chic! Gorgeous bridal fashion, a bridesmaid surprise and a wild ride in the mountains make this a real wedding journey.

programme.title: My Fair Wedding With David Tutera
programme.desc: Bride Danica planned a perfect red and white picnic for her wedding to firefighter Bryan. But she's having trouble feeling like a true bride without her mom, who passed away from breast cancer five years ago. Danica hasn't had the heart to shop for a bridal gown. She has apple pie on the menu, but no cake. And without a venue, this picnic wedding is in trouble! David Tutera takes Danica on an exciting and emotional journey. Along the way, Danica discovers her inner bride, and surprises David by embracing sparkle - everywhere! Her All-American wedding is red, white, and romantic.

programme.title: My Fair Wedding With David Tutera
programme.desc: High school sweethearts Lauren and Justin want to combine Chinese and Indian traditions at their wedding. But they recently lost their beachfront venue, and anxiety is ruining everything. They need wedding planner David Tutera, and fast! David arrives to find touches of Chinese red and Bollywood bright on Lauren's table, but nothing that makes this wedding theme pop! Even Lauren's bridesmaids' dresses are unbelievably bland. First stop; exotic, as David brings in colorful couture dresses, and the best of Chinese and Indian wedding traditions.

programme.desc: When David Tutera meets Heather Homan and Josh Tomes of Ontario, California, he finds a couple with a terrific theme for their wedding, but horrible execution. They want their wedding to be a celebration of love: hearts and the color pink everywhere but have wound up with a tacky disaster. From the zebra ties to the pink centerpieces to the glow sticks they plan to give to their guests; this couple really needs David’s expertise! Just when David thought it couldn’t get any worse, the couple tells him that, with only three weeks before the wedding, they don’t even have a venue yet! programme.desc: David Tutera faces one of the toughest challenges of his career when he meets Tasha and Evan of Los Angeles, California and finds out their theme: the board game “Monopoly”! With menus and centerpieces designed to resemble game cards, and a plan to have their guests pay for their food with fake money, David wonders if they’ve been planning a wedding or a child’s birthday party! Things get worse when David finds out that neither Tasha nor her brides like their dresses, which are far too revealing, and to top it off, they’re planning on having the ceremony and reception in a friend’s back yard! David had just three weeks to keep this couple’s dreams from going directly to jail!

programme.title: My Fair Wedding With David Tutera
programme.desc: David Tutera’s weddings work best when his couples incorporate something from their own life into their wedding as their theme, but when he meets Shirley and Andy from Los Angeles, California, he finds a theme that poses a huge challenge: belly dancing. Shirley absolutely loves her hobby but may have gone a little overboard in her planning: she plans to put herself and her brides in noisy shimmy belts, has peacock feather centerpieces, and to top it all off, she’s had a fake foam cake made to save money! Shirley’s bridesmaid dresses are a mismatched mess that don’t fit their body types, and when David sees Shirley’s dress, he’s floored by how big and dramatic it is, not at all matching Shirley’s personality or her theme. David’s biggest challenge might be yet to come, however, because Shirley’s venue for the wedding is a small Indian restaurant! In three weeks, David has to take this mismatched mess of a wedding and turn it into the ultimate sexy, exotic celebration of the art of belly dancing.

programme.title: My Fair Wedding With David Tutera

The items Tracey has put together are mismatched, and don’t speak to the regal, opulent feel that Tracey’s is looking for, and neither her gown nor her bridesmaids dresses are appropriate for a royal wedding. David has only three weeks to change every aspect of Tracey’s wedding to give her the royal wedding she’s always wanted.

programme.title: Jewish Gis
programme.desc: Jewish GIs of WWII tells the profound and unique story of the 550,000 Jewish men and women who served in World War II. Held as POWs and awarded honours for merit and valour, thousands were wounded and 11,000 were killed in action. Ten thousand Jewish women joined up as well, disregarding their parents' warnings that the military 'was no life for a nice Jewish girl'. In the midst of it all, they fought a second, more private battle against anti-Semitism within the ranks. They endured slurs and even violence from their fellow servicemen, and often felt forced to prove their courage and patriotism. Jewish Americans earned their citizenship by shedding blood, leaving their outsider status behind.

programme.desc: The fascinating story of groundbreaking cryptanalyst Elizebeth Smith Friedman.

programme.title: Holocaust Escape Tunnel
programme.desc: In the heart of Lithuania, a Holocaust secret lies buried. A team of archaeologists probes the ruins of a Nazi death camp to find the truth behind tales of a tunnel dug by desperate Jewish prisoners and their daring escape.

programme.title: Women of World War II: The Untold Stories
programme.desc: Women of World War II share the hidden history of how they saved– and changed– the world.

programme.title: Stella - A History of War
programme.desc: Based on the memoirs of Stella Kuylenstierna who fled the Soviet invasion of Hungary.

programme.title: Harbor From the Holocaust
programme.desc: In a Holocaust story of hope, 20,000 European Jews find refuge in Shanghai during WWII. Rivaling all elements and in tragic contrast to those who could not escape, it is a Holocaust story of life.

programme.title: Jewish Gis
programme.desc: Jewish GIs of WWII tells the profound and unique story of the 550,000 Jewish men and women who served in World War II. Held as POWs and awarded honours for merit and valour, thousands were wounded and 11,000 were killed in action. Ten thousand Jewish women joined up as well, disregarding their parents' warnings that the military 'was no life for a nice Jewish girl'. In the midst of it all, they fought a second, more private battle against anti-Semitism within the ranks. They endured slurs and even violence from their fellow servicemen, and often felt forced to prove their courage and patriotism. Jewish Americans earned their citizenship by shedding blood, leaving their outsider status behind.

programme.desc: What would you do if you had a sneaking suspicion that your partner was unfaithful, but you couldn’t prove it? Elizabeth and Shawn say they’re at the breaking point in their marriage because Elizabeth thinks her husband is cheating on her. Shawn says he has nothing to hide, and the biggest issue in their relationship is Elizabeth’s lack of trust. Recently, Elizabeth received a phone call in the middle of the night from a man who accused Shawn of sleeping with his wife. How does Shawn respond? Then, the accused husband says he’s willing to take a polygraph test to prove his innocence. Find out what happens when Dr. Phil offers to provide the test backstage. Will Elizabeth’s fears be allayed, or does she have a reason to be skeptical of her spouse?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Cheating, lying and sexual misconduct. Although public figures from John Edwards to Tiger Woods have admitted to this behavior, how would you handle accusations of infidelity in your own relationship? Tingle says she can’t trust her husband, Hermann. She says he lied about how many times he’d been married, and when she discovered he was registered on a singles dating site, he told her that he was doing research for a friend! She says she’s also suspicious of her spouse’s low sex drive and fears he may be getting his needs met elsewhere. Hermann says he wants to regain his wife’s trust but says he can’t handle her insecurity. Should Tingle give him another chance or kick him to the curb? And, when Elizabeth was last on the show, she wanted to know once and for all if her husband, Shawn, was being unfaithful. Find out why Shawn initially agreed to take a polygraph test but later declined. Can this relationship be saved?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tony Fort was just 10 years old when he says a man his mother trusted to watch him began grooming him, brainwashing him, and sexually abusing him. Tony says he was vulnerable and lonely, and he believed the older man was his best friend. Tony claims the man gave him dangerous, addictive drugs, telling him it was candy, and videotaped Tony being sexually abused. The man even followed Tony’s family when they moved to a new state, and he eventually abducted Tony. Authorities say they believe he had a sinister and dark plan for the little boy. Today, Tony speaks out for the first time about what happened to him.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.desc: On March 2, 2012, 19-year-old Jacob “Jake” Limberios was fatally shot in the head in the presence of three friends. The coroner ruled his death a suicide -- but Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say it doesn’t add up. They claim there was no investigation into Jake’s death, no evidence collected and no autopsy performed before Jake's death was ruled a suicide -- and they refuse to believe their son would take his own life. Jake’s family say a lot of questions remain unanswered, including: Who fired the shot? Two witnesses, Brittany and Will, adamantly maintain that Jake accidentally shot himself, but Mike and Shannon say their son knew how to handle guns safely and that the evidence doesn’t support that conclusion. Mike takes Dr. Phil cameras to the scene of the shooting to demonstrate why he believes that Jake was shot by someone else in the room. And, Brittany and Will face Mike and Shannon on Dr. Phil’s stage in an attempt to clear the cloud of suspicion that they say still follows them as a result of Mike and Shannon’s allegations. When offered a chance to take a polygraph test, will they accept? Don’t miss this compelling two-part mystery.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The family of 19-year-old Jake Limberios continues to search for answers surrounding his death in March 2012. Who fired the gunshot that ended his life? Brittany and Will, who witnessed the shooting, say Jake, a gun enthusiast, accidentally shot himself in the head. Although the coroner ruled his death a suicide, Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say their son, a young father, never would’ve taken his own life. Left with so many unanswered questions, Jake’s parents had his body exhumed and autopsied by renowned forensic pathologist Dr. Cyril Wecht, who concluded that Jake’s cause of death wasn’t suicide. Dr. Phil speaks with Dr. Wecht via satellite -- hear why he says Jake couldn’t have shot himself. Plus, Brittany and Will say they sympathize with Jake’s parents but are tired of being under suspicion and agree to take polygraph tests to prove they’re not hiding any details about Jake’s death. What will the results reveal? And, Mike and Shannon say their marriage has grown strained since their son’s death -- can they learn to come together and find peace after such a painful loss?

Seventeen-year-old Samantha sent an urgent plea for help to Dr. Phil. She says her ex-boyfriend, Aaron, called her nonstop for weeks and sent her threatening text messages after she broke up with him. After Samantha changed her number, he began calling her mother repeatedly. Samantha says he showed up unannounced at her house and pounded on the door for 45 minutes while she cowered in a locked closet. She says she’s afraid Aaron could even kill her. Dr. Phil sits down with the two teens to help Samantha get her message to Aaron loud and clear. And, Tiffany, 20, has a cautionary tale of survival every teen needs to hear. It could save her life!

Despite cutting the teen off financially, Dina says her ultimatums fell flat and fears they may only have pushed Sammie further into the arms of a boyfriend she thinks is bad news and may be dangerous. Sammie says her controlling mother and sheltered upbringing are the real problems - but, can she explain the bruises on her body? Then, Samantha is a teen who was blinded by her love affair with her allegedly abusive boyfriend, Aaron. programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A teen girl so obsessed with her on-again, off-again boyfriend that he claims she has become a stalker, forcing him to get a restraining order… for three years! Cristie says her 19-year-old daughter Corryn started dating 17-year-old Jack almost two years ago and every time they break up, Corryn becomes a “crazy ex-girlfriend.” Jack claims Corryn calls him hundreds of times a day, breaks into his house and hides behind the bushes to watch his every move, each time violating the restraining order. But Corryn says Jack plays games with her and lures her to him every time. Cristie and Jack’s mom, Brytt, say they’ve had it and want their teens’ relationship to end today -- but what does Corryn have to say about that? Can she stop obsessing over Jack, and will she keep a promise she made to Dr. Phil?

programme.desc: Some believe self-censorship is a big problem today, particularly in light of the idea that someone can be "canceled" for their words -- blocked from having a prominent public platform or career for sharing their opinion. Dr. Phil interviews Nate, a former Idaho police officer, who claims he was fired after making a TikTok video about NBA superstar LeBron James that went viral and has been viewed over 4 million times. Nate explains how the fall-out from the video affected him and his family, too. Dr. Phil also speaks with conservative political commentator Tomi Lahren, who says she recently had to be protected by state police from student protestors at the University of New Mexico. Greg Lukianoff, president of the Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression, says he believes Americans have lost the ability to discuss their differences rationally. And, Dr. Shaun Harper, founder and Executive Director of the USC Race and Equity Center, says he is firmly against hate speech and feels people need to be more mindful about the effects of their words.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

And, Dr. Phil takes a closer look at a list of terms that are now allegedly off limits. What words are on that list? Tune in to find out.

programme.desc: This Dr. Phil Family is angry, out of control, and about to get an intervention in The Dr. Phil House. Melissa, 22, wrote to Dr. Phil for help for her self-destructive family. Her mother, Myra, and her stepfather, Gene, have a long history of betrayals, infidelity, anger and years of bitter resentment. Melissa says her family even turns special occasions into volatile disasters with turkey dinners and Christmas trees being thrown across the room. The fighting got so bad, Melissa says she had to move away from her extreme family. Her brothers, Edwin, 20, and Eugene, 17, attest that their home is a war zone, and that they have witnessed fights between their parents that involve name-calling, spitting and dousing each other with water, all in front of their 7-year-old brother. Myra says she can’t forgive Gene for his four affairs, but especially the last one, which was with a 19-year-old. Over three years have passed since Gene’s last affair, but Myra still calls him a pedophile every chance she gets, and says she’d leave if it weren’t for their youngest child. Can this family learn to stop the drama, heal their anger and start over with a healthy foundation, or should they call it quits for good?

Dr. Phil and Morgan take a look at some of the most shocking stories of celebrities who have been "cancelled" in 2020, as well as some of the most tone-deaf mistakes made by the rich and famous. Also, how does Morgan keep his emotional and mental health in check during these trying times? Tune in to find out!

Watch while Dr. Phil weighs in on this fierce debate!

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: Explore the design flaws and human errors that condemned great ships to a tragic end. In 1628 the warship Vasa sank on her maiden voyage. Together with Vasa curator Fred Hocker, solve the mystery of why this great ship sank.

programme.title: Combat Ships

programme.title: Graveyard Carz

At the same time, Will primes the body of our 1969 Daytona, bringing it one step closer to being back on the road.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz

programme.title: Graveyard Carz

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark has once again taken Allysa under his wing and is teaching her the finer points of installing a grill and headlights on our 1972 Duster, meanwhile George is in the body shop attaching a tricky quarter panel to a 1969 ‘Cuda which Mark has to check off the list…military style? Finally, the Duster gets it’s drive train and is finally reunited with its engine.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Who better to explain the history and discuss the changes, year to year, of the Dodge Charger, than the Master of Mopar himself, Mark Worman. In this special episode of Graveyard Carz, Mark will show you unique differences, surprising insights, and cool features on multiple years of the same car: the Dodge Charger.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The focus has shifted, with parts having arrived at the shop it’s time to install the Grill, Bumper, Dash and Interior of our 1968 Turbine Bronze Charger. Mark and the Ghouls work their magic on the Charger until a familiar face shows up. With Royal there, Mark shifts the crew back to the 1 of 2 1970 Coronet and finishes the interior. Then, it’s time for a test drive!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With SEMA 2018 looming on the horizon, it’s time to address the elephant in the room. Mark’s 1964 A100 Hemi truck, the Little Dead Wagon, built as an homage to Bill Maverick’s Little Red Wagon. Will is set to prime and paint, but has a disagreement with Mark over the color. When the engine for the A100 shows up it’s time to unbox one of the most powerful engines Graveyard Carz has ever put in a car!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark and the Ghouls get down to work like never before in order to get the A100 ready for SEMA which is only weeks away. Brakes, suspension, tail lights, bed sealer, you name it and the Mopar Maniacs are racing to get it done. With time flying and stress mounting the team works long hours and weekends trying to finish this iconic build. With SEMA only days away, the A100 finally gets it’s iconic 426 HEMI engine, well, if they can make it fit!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: There is no time left, SEMA is almost here but the iconic A100 still needs some buttoning up. Installing all of the final components is an all hands on deck task and when the dust settles, Mark has only the decals left to put on the car, completing its legendary look. With the A100 finished the team heads out to SEMA in order to roll the Little Dead Wagon over the red carpet for Mopar and Mark once again receives a very kind gift from our friends.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: When Mark get’s started talking about a car there is almost no stopping him. So it is again when Mark picks multiple years of a favorite Mopar of his and tells both the audience, and whoever will listen all about their amazing options and cool differences. The Ghouls join in on the fun just like last time to pick their favorite things as well. Don’t worry, though, he can’t talk forever right?

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With SEMA over the Ghoulz can finally rest and get back to work on all the cars they had to leave untouched for the last few weeks…again. First up on deck is our beautiful 1972 Duster. Needing it’s Dash installed as well as it’s interior there is still a lot of work left on this car! Additionally, metal work has begun on a host of new cars moving up through the shop, it never stops at Graveyard Carz.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Dale searches for priceless motorcycles to bring to the Vegas auction.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: The Senior Vice President at Home Depot, Gordon Erickson at is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hard-ware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concourse have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, non Harley or Indian machines.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: With the Alfieri, Maserati in 2014 celebrated their anniversary with the introduction of a beautiful grand tourer. In remembrance and as part of the three-day celebration, Maserati organised a cruise from Bologna to Torino with some of their most iconic cars.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Mulsanne, Bentley's flagship car, provides luxury like in a first class hotel and elegance like an Armani suit. In addition: the Rolls-Royce Ghost. And: the high-tech coupe by Mercedes, the S 63 AMG with its V8 twin-turbo engine.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: With the i8, BMW tried to show the automotive world that they were ahead of their time. But why would anybody pay much more for a car that’s slower and less affordable than the brand's M4 and less spacious than the M5?

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Porsche's 911 GTS closed the gap between the S and the GT3 in their sports car model range. Also: the Roding Roadster, a handcrafted lightweight sports car with technology by BMW at its core.

programme.title: Put Your Car On TV
programme.desc: On Put Your Car On TV, car fans from the Middle East can have their darlings rated in terms of speed, style and sound. Included this time: a Nova SS, a special Honda Accord and a car clad in crystals.

programme.title: Put Your Car On TV
programme.desc: The "Walk" at JBR in Dubai is the venue for our competition, as far as fancy and luxurious cars from all over the Middle East are concerned. This time, a Lamborghini Aventador and a GMC Chevrolet are among the participants.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Chevrolet Corvette is the best-selling sports car in the world. It belongs to the USA like the Statue of Liberty, the Superbowl and John Wayne. Since its market launch the Corvette has developed into an automotive icon.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: 50 years of Porsche 911, 60 years of Chevrolet Corvette: two legends, two myths, two dream cars, and two philosophies. The Porsche 911 and the Chevrolet Corvette are the sports car icons in Europe and the USA.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: In no other industry is marketing as important as in the automotive industry. Brands, models and advertising campaigns have been closely intertwined for decades. How has car advertising developed since the 1990s? Part 3 of 3.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Three extraordinarily sporty SUVs are the Porsche Macan Turbo, the Mercedes GLA 45 AMG and the Audi RSQ3. Each of these is able to easily cope with each season of the year and, in regards to performance, could be mistaken for a sports car.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Porsche Panamera Turbo S is one of the most dynamic sedans in the world. In addition: the Jaguar XJR power sedan with a 550 hp V8 engine and Mercedes' extraordinary four-door coupe CLS 500.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Lexus was one of the pioneers when it comes to electric and hybrid cars. The brand's LS 600h, the BMW Active Hybrid 7 and the Porsche Panamera S E-Hybrid are prime examples of this mixture between combustion and electric propulsion.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Silvretta Hochalpenstrasse in Austria is the ideal playground for the lightweight power packs Lotus Elise and Roding Roadster. Also: the elegant but still very powerful Porsche 911 Targa 4S.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: With its extravagant design the Lexus NX200t definitely stands out. Infiniti, Nissan's luxury division, is more conservative in that regard. The QX30 features a classic Infiniti design with a curved bonnet. Also: the city SUV Mazda CX-3.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: The S version of the Jaguar F-Pace is a tough competitor for Porsche Macan Turbo other rivals. Also: Audi launched its SQ7 as the most powerful diesel SUV on the market. And: the Bentley Bentayga, the first luxury class SUV in the world.

programme.title: Put Your Car On TV
programme.desc: Mylene Gomera and Saif Hattawi once again invite the owners of the most extraordinary cars to Dubai, where they award points for speed, style and sound. This time, they will be joined by a limited edition Mercedes SLS and an Audi R8.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Audi is one of the most successful car manufacturers of the present day. The brand with the four rings stands for innovation, superior technology and unique design. Founded over 100 years ago, Audi is now a successful global player.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: In 1932, the economic crisis led to the merger of the Horch, DKW, Audi and Wanderer brands under the name Auto Union, the second largest German car manufacturer at the time, which made motor sport history with the famous Silver Arrow racing cars.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Aston Martin's Vantage N430 model is a sports car that makes drivers and enthusiasts feel the heritage of British race cars. Also: a combination of elegance and power, the Bentley Continental GTC Speed with its W12 Twin Turbo engine.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: In 2014, Mercedes-Benz presented their first Plug-in Hybrid, the S500. When it comes to Bentley, a V8 engine means down-sizing. We took a look at the brand's Flying Spur model with a smaller engine. And: the 6th generation Maserati Quattroporte.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: After its introduction the Audi RS6 was the benchmark when it came to extreme estate cars. Its performance was already very impressive, but according to the Audi tuners that still wasn't enough.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Do you want to feel like a racing driver without being limited to a race track? If so, the British manufacturer Radical is the right choice, as the company builds race cars with road approval. Their RXC is a powerful and agile racer.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Few manufacturers have been as active in the USA and Europe as early as Ford - and with success. While the Mustang thrilled American youth, the Capri turned the heads of Europeans.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Porsche has competed in the 24-hour Le Mans classic every year since 1951. The company's prototypes have won 18 times - more often than the vehicles of any other manufacturer in the history of this racing series.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: This episode focuses on the 6th generation of two US classics, the Ford Mustang GT and the Chevrolet Corvette Z06, these iconic sports cars' history and development over the past decades.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: How do you top the already in many ways superior iconic Porsche 911? You come up with the GT3. It's the ultimate melange of road suitability and race track compatibility. And Porsche's RS model is even more intense.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Ferrari's California T model heralded a new era for the Italian sports car manufacturer. After its facelift the T was the first Ferrari with a turbo engine since the iconic F40 which was built until 1992.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Since its establishment in 1919, Bentley consistently drew attention thanks to their ongoing success in motor sports. The limited edition Continental GT3-R was one of the iconic manufacturer's sportiest cars ever.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: At the beginning of the 1970s, Volkswagen is in crisis. The company has no answer to the oil crisis and no successor to the Beetle. It was only with the new generation Passat and Golf cars that Volkswagen returned to the fast lane. Part 2 of 2.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: For more than 50 years the Porsche 911 has been holding the crown as one of the best sports cars in the world. Two manufacturers recently jousted with the 911, with the Jaguar F-Type R and the Mercedes AMG GT S as Porsche’s rivals.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Tesla Model S was the world's first premium sedan that was developed from scratch as an electric car. Tesla showed the world that electromobility can be sexy and that it works. We took a closer look at the Model S P85D.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Mercedes‘ S-Class Coupe is a real masterpiece. We explored what the S 63 AMG Coupe has to offer in comparison to the Bentley Continental and the Rolls Royce Wraith.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: With the Ghibli, Maserati advanced into a more affordable market segment. But the competition is strong. In addition: taking the Maserati GranCabrio MC on a cruise through the Alps.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Power, passion, pole position - Mercedes-Benz has been writing motorsport history for 120 years. The list of successes of the brand with the star is long. As early as 1894, at the first motor race, a Daimler and a Benz competed.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The second part of our series on Mercedes Motorsport covers the comeback of Mercedes after the accident at Le Mans, the beginnings in rallying in the 1960s, the countless successes in the DTM up to the Formula 1 World Championships.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Aston Martin V12 Vantage S Roadster with its 6-litre V12 engine is probably the most amazing export from the UK. In addition: a mountain cruise from dawn to sundown with the Corvette C7 Convertible.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Porsche Cayman GT4 combined the best elements that Porsche could offer. In addition: the Audi R8 V10 plus, an even stronger, lighter and faster version of the original model.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Even in the world of super sports cars people get goose bumps if they hear the name Lamborghini. Wherever they’re spotted, the Huracan and the Aventador always receive lots of attention.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: After the Second World War, the silver of the Mercedes racing cars quickly becomes the colour of the winners again. In the slipstream of their own myth, the second-generation Silver Arrows go from victory to victory.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Mercedes-Benz once dominated the rally scene with the 180D or the 220 and 300SE touring saloons. In the 1960s and 70s, the company used rallying for testing because the use of near-production vehicles was mandatory there.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Porsche Cayenne Turbo and the Range Rover Supercharged are big and have a lot of power, so that they could even take on sports cars. Also: with the Bentayga, Bentley presented the brand's first SUV model. And: the Jaguar F-Pace.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Tushek TS600, a limited edition super sports car had a power/weight ratio that is on the level of GT3 racing cars. The Bentley Continental GT3-R special edition was also limited whereas McLaren offered their 570S to all customers.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The German manufacturer Roding created a car that even outshined the Porsche GT3 with an impressive power/weight ratio. British makes like the Caterham 620 R, Lotus Elise or Radical RXC also showed what's in play in regards to lightweight sports cars.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The German company Performmaster upgraded the Mercedes C63 AMG S, chip tuning from the Racechip company gave the Porsche Macan Turbo even more bite and Kellener did their take on the BMW 640i.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: From the Mercedes-Benz 300 SEL AMG to the DTM, from Le Mans to Indianapolis, from the classic Silver Arrows to the Formula 1 World Championship. We shed light on the return of the new Mercedes-Benz Silver Arrows to racing.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: In the first part of the Mercedes-Benz company history, we look at the history of Carl Benz, Gottlieb Daimler and Mercedes, from the first Patent-Motorwagen to the dream cars of the 1930s, the Mercedes 500K and the 770.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Nissan's all-wheel monster GT-R had to prove its winter suitability and the new Porsche 911 with turbo engine was taken to its limits in Finnish Lapland. Also: the Mercedes-Benz S 500 plug-in hybrid.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: With its extreme power and performance the Croatian super car Rimac Concept One opened the door to an exciting new world. Also: the Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG Coupe Electric Drive. And: Tesla's impressive Model S series.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: They are big, heavy and embody the American way of driving: luxury SUVs like the Cadillac Escalade, classic pick-up trucks like the iconic Ford F-150 or Uber pick-ups like the Dodge RAM.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Remember the first Beetle? When did Ferdinand Porsche design the ‘people‘s car’? We follow the evolution of the automobile over the last century. The ultimate automotive hall of fame. Discover heroes of the past and immortal four-wheelers. We show you the evolution of the ultimate car legends.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: After the Second World War, Mercedes-Benz vehicles quickly became the epitome of status, quality, performance and comfort once again - from the 300SL Gullwing, the W 110/111 "tail fin" and from the A- to the S-Class.
